data.one_liner: Provides barcode and QR code scanning on Android and iOS via native camera APIs.
data.what_it_does: The plugin opens a camera view, scans barcodes or QR codes, and returns the result as a string. It supports one‑time scans and continuous streaming of results.
use_when: You need quick barcode/QR scanning without writing native code
You want a simple API that works on both Android and iOS
avoid_when: You require advanced image processing or custom detection models
You need cross‑platform support for web or desktop
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single method call
Supports continuous scanning via a stream
Handles iOS Swift setup and permission configuration
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS only
No built‑in support for custom detection logic
Relies on native UI, so UI customization is minimal
data.setup_notes: iOS requires Swift support, deployment target >=12, Swift version 5, and adding NSCameraUsageDescription to Info.plist; Android works out‑of‑the‑box but ensure flutter_plugin_android_lifecycle is present.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers similar scanning features with additional support for custom overlay UI and better performance on newer devices

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_barcode_scanning
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides on‑device ML‑Kit barcode detection with more format support and no need for native UI

alternatives.name: barcode
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pure Dart implementation, works on all platforms including web
